gauge.name: Third Fork Creek at Woodcroft Park

impacts.statement: Moderate flooding begins on the lower athletic fields at Woodcroft Club.
Minor flooding begins. Water begins to flow across Woodcroft Pkwy.
Water reaches the base of the bridge on Woodcroft Pkwy.

dataAttribution.title: Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
